s1.syndrome_frame: asymptomatic solitary thoracic nodule with increased metabolic activity
salient_findings: 20-mm homogeneous, well-defined nodule in the right paratracheal region
no change in nodule size after 3 months
key_facts: 67-year-old man
undergoing evaluation for sigmoid colon cancer
contrast-enhanced CT showed a nodule in the right paratracheal region
FDG-PET showed increased uptake in the lesion
maximum SUV of 5.3
asymptomatic
unremarkable medical and family history
normal blood tests except for mild leukocytosis
laparoscopic sigmoidectomy performed
pathologic stage I sigmoid colon cancer
repeat CT 3 months later showed no change in nodule size

shortlist.label: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: High FDG uptake and solitary thoracic nodule are consistent with lymphoma

shortlist.label: Metastatic lung disease
shortlist.why_kept: History of sigmoid colon cancer and solitary thoracic nodule with high FDG uptake suggest possible metastasis

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Solitary thoracic nodule with high FDG uptake can be seen in sarcoidosis, although less likely given the patient's age and lack of other symptoms

shortlist.label: Pulmonary hamartoma
shortlist.why_kept: Solitary thoracic nodule with high FDG uptake can be seen in hamartomas, although typically they have lower SUV values

shortlist.label: Hodgkin lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Solitary thoracic nodule with high FDG uptake can be seen in Hodgkin lymphoma, although less common than non-Hodgkin lymphoma in this age group

raw.rationale: High FDG uptake (SUV of 5.3) and initial suspicion of malignant lymphoma or metastatic lymph node, given the clinical context of recent sigmoid colon cancer diagnosis

rejected.label: Metastatic lung disease
rejected.why: No change in nodule size after 3 months, which is less typical for metastatic disease

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Typically presents with multiple nodules and often has systemic symptoms, which are not present in this case

rejected.label: Pulmonary hamartoma
rejected.why: Usually has low FDG uptake and a characteristic 'popcorn' calcification pattern on CT, not mentioned in this case

rejected.label: Hodgkin lymphoma
rejected.why: Less common than Non-Hodgkin lymphoma and often presents with systemic symptoms and a more typical lymph node distribution
